scope: Read-only source and existing offline server core analysis; no native invocation, source mutation, message injection, or credential fabrication.

candidate_explanation.status: Static plausible lifecycle race; not yet demonstrated as this run exact root cause
sequence: Exec success is delivered asynchronously by exec listener HangUp monitor; callback sets Process::_pendingReplacement.
If main image checkin is processed before that monitor, notifyCheckin sees no pending replacement.
A later new pthread checkin can consume _pendingReplacement: Checkin::processCall ignores body.is_fork and calls process->notifyCheckin for every thread.
notifyCheckin exec branch retains only mainThread and calls notifyDead on every nonmain thread, including the thread currently performing Checkin.
notifyDead unregisters that child. Checkin reply enters Thread::pushCallReply, which drops replies when _dead, leaving client blocked in recvmsg.

diagnostic_next_step: Passively record main/child Checkin and setPendingReplacement ordering, plus notifyDead current caller and child nsid, on controlled next native attempt. Do not paper over by unconditional reply injection.
